Make a point-and-click adventure with p5.js

Rooms, clickable objects, a hero who walks, an inventory, cutscenes and conversations. Describe the game as data, then write what happens as small scripts.

LearnShort lessons with a live, editable game on every page. Start here if you are new. DocsEvery function, property and option, with examples. Generated from the source. ExamplesComplete small games to play and read.

The whole thing, in one screen

Load p5, load p5.clickery, and describe a room. That is a game you can walk around in:

let game;

async function setup() {
  game = createGame({
    rooms: [{
      id: 'yard', width: 640, height: 360, color: '#2d3a55',
      starts: { default: { x: 80, y: 300 } },
      walkable: [{ id: 'floor', points: [[0, 250], [640, 250], [640, 340], [0, 340]] }],
    }],
  });
  await game.start();
}

function draw() {
  game.draw();
}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2/lib/p5.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://flooowlab.github.io/p5.clickery/dist/p5.clickery.min.js"></script>
